meals.name: Chicken Milanese with Tomato & Mozzarella Rigatoni
meals.description: Crisp Parmesan-breaded chicken breast with rigatoni in a garlic-chilli tomato sauce, torn mozzarella, Parmesan and basil.
instructions: Flatten the chicken breast evenly, then flour, egg and coat with breadcrumbs mixed with Parmesan.
Fry until crisp and cooked through, then rest on a rack.
Cook the rigatoni and toss with a garlic-chilli passata sauce.
Fold mozzarella and basil through the pasta and serve alongside the Milanese, keeping sauce off the crust.

meals.name: Pork Tenderloin, Mustard Cream Sauce, Mash & Spinach
meals.description: Seared pork tenderloin with a shallot, white wine, Dijon-wholegrain mustard cream sauce, buttery mash and wilted spinach.
instructions: Boil the potatoes until tender and mash with butter.
Sear the pork tenderloin, then finish until just cooked and rest.
Sweat shallot in the pan, deglaze with white wine, add stock, reduce, then finish with Dijon, wholegrain mustard and cream.
Wilt the spinach and serve with sliced pork, mash and sauce.

meals.name: Crispy Salmon, Soy & Egg Fried Rice, Tenderstem
meals.description: Crispy-skin salmon with soy and egg fried jasmine rice, charred tenderstem broccoli and a light soy glaze.
instructions: Cook the jasmine rice and let excess steam escape.
Sear the salmon skin-side down until crisp, then finish gently on the flesh side.
Stir-fry garlic and spring onion, scramble in the eggs, then add rice, soy and sesame oil.
Char the tenderstem and finish the salmon with a light soy-honey glaze.

meals.name: Sichuan Peanut Noodles with Charred Chicken Thigh & Smashed Cucumber
meals.description: Charred soy-Shaoxing chicken thighs over rich Sichuan peanut noodles with a cold smashed cucumber salad.
instructions: Marinate the chicken briefly with soy and Shaoxing, then char until cooked through.
Whisk peanut butter, soy, black vinegar, sesame oil, garlic, chilli crisp and a splash of noodle water into a glossy sauce.
Boil the noodles and toss through the sauce.
Smash and season the cucumber, then plate with sliced chicken, spring onion, sesame and Sichuan pepper.

meals.name: Steak au Poivre, Frites & Dressed Salad
meals.description: Pan-seared sirloin with a cognac/brandy peppercorn cream sauce, crispy air-fryer chips and a lemon-Dijon dressed side salad.
instructions: Season and sear the sirloin to the desired doneness, then rest it.
Cook the frozen frites until crisp.
Sweat the shallot in the steak pan, deglaze with brandy, add stock and reduce, then finish with cream and cracked black pepper.
Dress the salad leaves with lemon, Dijon and olive oil, then plate with the rested steak and sauce.
